evidence: Contains/Count/FindAll (string+span) and Text.Substring/Slice on public ISuffixTree, any pattern length; MMF tree built on chr1 (249 Mbp) in GenomeDemo. Positions unsorted, int-indexed (<2^31 chars).
No pattern classes in the tree. Workaround: MotifFinder.FindDegenerateMotif (15 IUPAC DNA codes) is an O(n*m) window scan on the raw string, not index-based; DnaSequence rejects N.
No backtracking over the tree. ApproximateMatcher FindWithMismatches/FindWithEdits (Hamming scan, Sellers DP) is a separate O(n*m) raw-string routine; MCP count_approximate_occurrences wraps it.

FindMaximalExactMatches, FindMaximalUniqueMatches(Both|Reference), FindMaximalRepeatedPairs: complete sets, O(n+m+R), parity with MUMmer 3.23 documented. Forward strand only; validated to 2 kb (MEM), 200 kb (pairs).

FindExactMatchAnchors streams the query via suffix links (one first-peak anchor per ms>=minLength run); the ms[] array itself is not public (AdvanceMatchingStatistics is private); MEM/MUM build on it.

Static SuffixTree.FindLongestCommonSubstrings(texts,minSupport) and LongestCommonSubstringLengthsBySupport via concatenated GST + Hui colour counting; one-shot, no reusable multi-text index, no document listing/counting.

No strand-aware search/index; MEM/MUM/repeat pairs forward only. Workaround: DnaSequence.ReverseComplement + second query; RepeatFinder.FindReverseComplementRepeats uses an internal SA of S#revcomp(S), not the tree.

Public: Traverse(ISuffixTreeVisitor) gives string depth, leaf/child counts, sorted keys. Suffix links, child lookup, LCA only via ISuffixTreeNavigator, whose implementations and the in-memory node are internal.

Tree-based: LongestRepeatedSubstring, FindAllLongestRepeatedSubstrings, CountDistinctSubstrings(+ByLength), FindMaximalRepeatedPairs. Supermaximal repeats exist only as a separate SA routine in RepeatFinder.

Single-threaded Ukkonen, O(n), class nodes. Only measured figure in repo: 10 Mbp random DNA build+1 query+sort = 23.3 s (~0.43 Mbp/s, in-memory, 2026-10-01). Persistent build has extra finalize passes, no figure.
In-memory ~170 B/char (10 Mbp = ~1.7 GB; class nodes, doc comment claiming 20 B/char is wrong). Persistent ~66 B/char file plus ~50 B/char temp child/depth MMFs during build; plain SA is ~5 B/char.

Contains/Count O(m): <=4 inline children per node (in-memory; DNA never uses the Dictionary path), binary search over mmap child array O(m log d) (persistent); LeafCount precomputed. No latency numbers published.

64-bit node offsets via compact-to-large hybrid layout, but text length, NODE_COUNT and ITextSource.Length are int32: max 2^31-1 chars. Human genome (3.1 Gbp) needs per-chromosome trees; chr1 only as a demo app.

MMF-backed build (temp child/depth MMFs) and read-only mmap query keep nodes off the managed heap, but it is OS paging of in-core Ukkonen: no semi-external algorithm, no out-of-RAM timing; input text/results in RAM.
No parallel construction: Ukkonen build loop is sequential and no Parallel/Task/Thread use anywhere in src/SuffixTree (grep); only concurrent reads are supported.
Tree immutable after build, thread-safe reads documented; Parallel.For tests on in-memory and MMF trees (1000-5000 iterations); ThreadStatic scratch buffers; construction itself not thread-safe.
Ukkonen is online internally (private ExtendTree) but there is no public Append/insert/delete; trees are immutable after Build and persistent files are read-only after build.
No compressed/succinct index in the repo (no FM-index/CSA/BWT). Persistent tree ~66 B/char (24 B nodes + 8 B child entries), >10x a plain SA; the ASCII flag only halves the stored text.

Arbitrary UTF-16 code units (uint keys, terminator -1; Unicode/binary tests), but no integer/larger alphabets and no 2-bit sigma=4 path; DNA only gets a 1-byte ASCII text flag; surrogate pairs are 2 symbols.

Documented v6 binary format, read-only mmap Load, version field (only v6, no migration), header/bounds validation; SHA256 structural hash only in portable export/import (rebuilds). No body checksum on native file.

Native .NET 10: ISuffixTree interfaces, ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads, ITextSource/mmap text, ArgumentNull/ObjectDisposed contracts, AOT/trim flags. Warts: unsorted int positions, Create returns non-IDisposable type.

Only channel is a stdio MCP server (18 tools, 12 core tool docs). No PackageId in any SuffixTree csproj (no NuGet release); apps are demo/stress/benchmark harnesses, not a CLI; MCP tools rebuild the tree per call.

~940 NUnit cases, CsCheck properties, brute-force oracles, in-memory=persistent parity, header fuzz, MUMmer 3.23 literal outputs locked; CI runs dotnet test on the sln. Large MUMmer comparisons documented, not in CI.
